ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface area; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized primarily on the lateral margins and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white blobs are concentrated on the lower-outer quadrants of both lobes. The medial and central regions consist of a contiguous low-intensity dark field, interspersed with discrete, high-contrast circular micro-blobs (rosettes) ranging from 5-15 pixels in diameter.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 135 degrees and a relatively shallow depth ratio relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge exhibits 4-5 high-amplitude, sharp triangular peaks near the distal tip. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits lower-amplitude, high-frequency irregular serrations along the entire boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch, transitioning into a jagged, linear-approximated path towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of circular, high-contrast white rings (rosettes) are distributed across the dark field of both lobes, with a higher density observed on the medial left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel and intersecting thin, high-intensity linear segments (rake marks) are visible on the inner-medial regions of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (barnacle attachment sites) and distinct linear rake-like marks across the ventral surface; significant jagged irregularity on the far-right trailing edge tip.
